title: Stealth bomber over Altadena on New Year's Day
summary: Michael Shermer tells of Stealth bomber over Altadena on New Year's Day, about an unknown time at Altadena, California, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Uh and other examples I use like um seeing the stealth bomber fly over my house when I lived in Aladena.

plain: Michael Shermer, a researcher known as a leading skeptic, told the podcast host Jesse Michels that when he lived in Altadena, California, he once saw a stealth bomber, a US military plane with an odd flat, wing-shaped body, fly over his house on New Year's Day. He uses it as an example of how a real but unusual aircraft could be mistaken for something otherworldly.
